revision: S3/R2: recording hardware removed. Upper pot shafts Y41; lower pot shafts Y75 (34 mm row pitch), lower pots rotated 180 degrees to keep their solder pins above the bodies. Vactrol moved down 3.3 mm to Y88 to clear the lower pots. Native PCB owns routing.
frame: Panel frame: origin at the panel upper-left corner seen from the front, X across (right), Y down, mm. KiCad sheet position = kicad_origin + panel XY. The main PCB F side faces the panel, so the KiCad top view equals the front view (no mirroring).
rail_note: Doepfer single hole pair at X7.5 (HOLE_X0 in case/tools/build_case.py; the Bread Modular Panel_6HP has the same pair). Skiff rails as the MIDI module: clear Y8.0..120.5.

main_pcb.note: 29 x 110 mm; four layers F/In1 GND/In2 +3V3/B. All assembled SMD on B. 1 mm copper-edge keep-out.

panel_order: MIDI + NOISE IN; NOISE TONE + BLUE TONE; ENV LED; CUTOFF + DECAY; AUDIO OUT + HAT CV OUT. No recording controls.
row_note: Pot shaft rows Y41 and Y75, 34 mm pitch (was 24). Lower pots face 180 degrees with solder pins at Y67.5. ENV LED remains Y54.8. Vactrol centre X7/Y88; input/output jacks unchanged.
pot_part: Song Huei R0904N 50k / 1M linear (user stock), vertical snap-in, tall shaft (L = 25 mm, knurled, no threaded bushing, no nut): the pot Bread Modular uses, on the Bread Modular Potentiometer_RV09 footprint
led_note: D5 ENV only: 3 mm THT on F, body centre X15 Y54.8, anode to the right; dome flush with panel front.

stack_Z_mm.note: As modules/8bit (LED dome flush with the 1.6 mm FR4 panel front).

vactrol_part: Chinese VTL5C-type vactrol, Bread Modular VTL5C footprint + modules/low courtyard, hand-soldered on B.

vactrols.note: VCA on B; centre Y88 (3.3 mm lower than R1), lead rows Y81.65/94.35. Clears the rotated lower pots and output-jack holes; no overlapping button.

power_header.orientation: Horizontal along the bottom edge (user direction 2026-10-23), rot 270 on B as modules/vca-mix: odd pins on the upper row Y113.4, even pins on Y115.94; pins 1/2 (-12 V) at the left, pins 9/10 (+12 V) at the right. Courtyard Y111.61..117.73 (1 mm edge keep-out: board edge Y119.25).
power_header.idc_note: A 16-pin cable plugs on aligned at pin 1 (red stripe = -12 V, at the left); positions 11-16 overhang to the right, over the board, never past an edge. Envelope = 2x8 socket (25.4 x 6.4 mm body, 3.81 mm beyond the end pin centres) plus a 1.2 mm key bump on either side. No THT pad under it (out-jack sleeve pads end at Y109.53). B-side SMD placed under it later must stay <= 2 mm tall.

back_side_tht.note: bottom edge, horizontal, as modules/vca-mix power_header (rot 270 on B)
NOISE MCU (U2) UPDI: pin 1 UPDI Y30.0, pin 2 GND Y32.54, right edge between NOISE IN and BLUE TONE
HIHAT MCU (U3) UPDI: pin 1 UPDI Y30.0, pin 2 GND Y32.54, left edge between MIDI and NOISE TONE

smd_parking.note: Every SMD part waits here, off the board edge, in reference order; it moves onto the board with its functional group (root AGENTS.md divide and conquer).
